tours.name: Delete a Time Off Request
tours.description: Learn how to remove a time off request that was entered by mistake and is still waiting for approval. Requests cannot be archived, only deleted.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to remove a time off request that was entered by mistake and is still waiting for approval. Requests cannot be archived, only deleted.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: Requests of all employees are managed in the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: Requests of all employees are managed in the Time Off app.

steps.title: Management menu
steps.description: The Management menu holds the requests and allocations of all employees.

description_i18n.en_US: The Management menu holds the requests and allocations of all employees.

steps.title: Time Off
steps.description: Every request of every employee is listed here, grouped by status.

description_i18n.en_US: Every request of every employee is listed here, grouped by status.

steps.title: Find the employee
steps.content: Type the employee's name and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the employee's name and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you open the right request. Only delete a request you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you open the right request. Only delete a request you no longer need.

steps.title: Open the group
steps.content: Click the group to show the requests inside it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the group to show the requests inside it.

steps.description: Requests are grouped, for example by status or period. Click the heading to show them.

description_i18n.en_US: Requests are grouped, for example by status or period. Click the heading to show them.

steps.title: Open the request
steps.content: Click the request to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the request to open it.

steps.description: The request form shows the dates, the type and the status.

description_i18n.en_US: The request form shows the dates, the type and the status.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to this request is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to this request is in this menu.

steps.title: Delete
steps.description: Odoo only lets you delete a request that is still a draft or waiting for approval. An approved or refused request must first be set back to draft with the Mark as Draft button. Deleting removes the request for good, so only do it for requests made by mistake.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo only lets you delete a request that is still a draft or waiting for approval. An approved or refused request must first be set back to draft with the Mark as Draft button. Deleting removes the request for good, so only do it for requests made by mistake.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Delete in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Delete in the window to confirm.

steps.description: Odoo asks once more because deleting cannot be undone.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo asks once more because deleting cannot be undone.
